mapper.select: SELECT m.id membership_id,m.status,m.generation,m.version,u.status principal_status,u.version principal_version,m.valid_from::text,m.valid_to::text FROM auth_governance.membership m JOIN auth_governance.principal u ON u.id=m.principal_id WHERE m.id=#{member} AND m.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND u.kind='HUMAN'

SELECT e.source_id,e.aggregate_id,e.aggregate_version,e.payload_hash,jsonb_build_object('status',e.payload_json->'employee'->>'status','assignments',e.payload_json->'employee'->'assignments','parent_id',null)::text facts_json, ((SELECT count(*) FROM auth_governance.directory_version_receipt v WHERE v.source_id=e.source_id AND v.aggregate_type=e.aggregate_type AND v.aggregate_id=e.aggregate_id) > (SELECT count(DISTINCT c.aggregate_version) FROM auth_governance.directory_change_evidence c WHERE c.source_id=e.source_id AND c.aggregate_type=e.aggregate_type AND c.aggregate_id=e.aggregate_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.directory_change_evidence c WHERE c.source_id=e.source_id AND c.aggregate_type=e.aggregate_type AND c.aggregate_id=e.aggregate_id AND c.before_json IS NULL AND c.aggregate_version>1 AND c.outcome='APPLIED')) history_missing FROM auth_governance.directory_entry e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND e.membership_id=#{member} ORDER BY e.source_id LIMIT 101

SELECT s.id source_id,s.last_sequence,s.quarantined,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(reason ORDER BY reason)::text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT reason FROM auth_governance.directory_conflict c WHERE c.source_id=s.id ORDER BY reason LIMIT 64) r),'[]') conflict_reasons FROM auth_governance.directory_source s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 101

SELECT c.source_id,c.event_id,c.partition_sequence,c.aggregate_type,c.aggregate_id,c.aggregate_version,c.event_fingerprint,c.outcome,c.before_json::text,c.after_json::text,c.occurred_at::text FROM changes c WHERE (c.source_id,c.partition_sequence) > (#{source},#{sequence}) ORDER BY c.source_id,c.partition_sequence LIMIT 101

SELECT g.id grant_id,g.version,CASE WHEN p.state='BLOCKED' OR d.state='BLOCKED' THEN 'BLOCKED' WHEN g.state='REVOKED' AND r.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND p.state='READY' AND p.applied_epoch>=o.target_epoch AND d.state='READY' THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'PROCESSING' END status, r.operation_id,p.desired_epoch,p.applied_epoch FROM auth_governance.access_grant g JOIN auth_governance.policy_partition p ON p.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND p.application_id=g.application_id AND p.environment=g.environment JOIN auth_governance.directory_fence d ON d.tenant_id=g.tenant_id LEFT JOIN auth_governance.projection_grant_receipt r ON r.grant_id=g.id AND r.grant_version=g.version LEFT JOIN auth_governance.projection_operation o ON o.id=r.operation_id AND o.fence_id=p.id WHERE g.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND g.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND g.environment=#{p.environment} AND g.id IN #{id} ORDER BY g.id LIMIT 100
